title: 第两千四百零五章 填补遗憾第两千四百零四章 格局问题
content_zh:
“你们很有冲劲！”赖永昌说。
谢瑜对赖永昌说：“今天请你来呀，就是为了解决问题的嘛！这里，今晚，我的主场啦！林总，谢谢你提供的场地呀！谢谢了！”
安静和两个保安依然站在露台不远处，没走。而两个保安也不时看着这里。我想了一下，还是将三人召了过来：
“你们是有事？”
安静犹豫了一下，还是带着两个保安过来了：“哦，凡哥哦林总…”
我打断了她：“平时怎么叫我的就怎么叫啊，没必要改口。”
安静明显放松下来：“凡哥，哦，还有龙凤哥，我有事要向你汇报。是这样的，这两位我部门的同事，一位是思壁村的，另一位是山后村的。两位都报名参军，通过了！准备去报道了！”
“哎呀，恭喜恭喜！”我说，“我以前想参军还参不了呢！你们能过，说明你们无论是身体体格健康还是政审方面都是符合国家要求的，好事啊！怎么这个表情呢？我们度假村是小家，国是大家，舍小家保卫大家，理所当然的呀！我要广而告之呢！”
两位保安说：“林总，哦，凡哥！谢谢你！”
“谢我干啥啊？”我说，“这都是你们自己不放松对自己的要求才有今天的成就啊！”
“若不是在度假村里天天坚持安保工作方面的训练，我们也不一定有这样的体格啊！”两位保安其中一位说，“还有思想上的原则坚持，在度假村里，每天都是有教导的，坚持原则坚持立场，所以我们才养成了这样的标准。今天过来，就是想和你说声谢谢，同时请您签名，我们辞职了！有点不舍，但正如你所说，舍小家保大家，是我们要去做的，能去做的。”
“嘿，辞职？”我看看龙凤哥，他心领神会，“辞职啊？不批！”
“啊？”安静愣住了，现场的人都愣住了。
“我说不批就不批！”龙凤哥说这话时候还是正儿八经的，说完之后就笑了，“干嘛要批啊？就算你去当兵，也不是要我们在辞职信上签名的原因！我们不批！在两位服役期间，度假村的工资奖金照发！也当我们度假村做的一点点贡献吧！服役期满了之后，你俩愿意回来度假村继续工作的，工龄还是照算的呀！不过我得告诉你俩啊！你俩过去服役了，别丢我们银海湾的脸，别丢你们村的脸，别丢你们自己的脸，也别丢我们度假村的脸！记住了啊！”
两人完全没想到是这样的结果，老半天杵在原地。
我说：“哎，你俩！怎么跟大木头似的不动啊！听到了就记住了哈！就五个字：别丢我们的脸！”
谢瑜笑了：“林凡，这是六个字啊！你的数学…”
“嘿，怪大张伟啊！”我摸摸后脑勺，“他整天说天空飘来五个字！明明是七个字，误导我！”
龙凤哥对安静说：“你这边呢，他俩的编制不变，每个月的工资报表和年终奖照报！不能少了他们的！还有，另外将他俩父母的名字报过来，拿到银行账号，我们度假村每个月要发生活费给他俩父母的！我们度假村出了新兵，光荣感总要沾沾吧？哈哈！”
两个保安一听这么安排，感动，抿着嘴没出声。

我看了说：“哎，没其他事了？那行！安静你确认一下时间，度假村顺便安排送兵宴！这就真定了啊！”
等安静带着两个保安离开后，赖永昌对我说：“林总格局真的值得我们学习啊！”
我笑笑：“哎，保家卫国，每个中国人都是刻在基因里的吧？我以前去报名当兵，没通过，素鸡体检没通过，而是名额就这么几个，我排名靠后，遗憾呢！我遗憾，我老爸更加感到遗憾。他是当兵出身，所以才离开了老家，才有今天。我当年没当上兵，我爸都说少了那锻炼机会，真可惜。然后第二年我又报名，还是因为排名靠后，体质过关，但还是不够别人优秀。念念不忘啊！所以，现在我们度假村有人当兵，这份工资我们还是出得起的。”
“凡哥，那两个保安的空缺，我们马上招？”龙凤哥问。
“那是肯定的啦！”我说，“你的事儿，不用问我的。”
“这不是看着菜还没送上来，我怕没话题可说，就加进来问一句呗！”他笑嘻嘻的看着我。
大家都笑了。
赖永昌唉了一声：“林总你说的很对。第一次没把握好，第二次再不把握，就说不过去了。”
谢瑜赶紧扯开话题：“对的！对了，林…哦总，今晚什么菜啊！我看着不远处已经开始送过来了吧？有小火车来了啊！”
我两手一摊：“我母鸡啊！问龙凤哥这个食家咯！”
龙凤哥说：“能安排的都安排。但是你们放心，绝对不会浪费！哦，我们都还是一直响应姚明所说的，没有买卖就没有伤害，鱼翅这玩意，我们坚决不碰！就连碗仔翅也不会有。鱼虾蟹啦！不是梭哈的那种鱼虾蟹啊，是真正海里的那种，有养殖的，有野生的，都是思壁村村主任严选的，哎，不用看着我，村主任是可以商业经营的，他有自己的渔船和门路。但是，没有生腌，没有刺生，为安全着想。然后，还有川菜，正宗的啊！为什么说是正宗的呢？因为厨师是四川的，地道品种，我们凡哥认识十几年的厨师，当年他考厨师牌，都是凡哥助理和支持他的。所以，他哪里也不愿意去，就来银海湾，我们大榕树餐厅的主厨。”
“吃得完吗？”谢瑜问。
“吃不完？”我笑了，“我们从不浪费食物。计算着出品的。浪费的百分比是有严控的，超过那个比例，谁主导，谁买单的。”
“那万一遇上飞来客呢？”谢瑜说，“那不是有生意也做不了吗？不可惜呀？我怎么觉得太可惜啦？加加班不就行了？就半个小时，比如消费300元，毛利怎么都150元吧？纯利怎么都100元吧？不好吗？”
content_en:
"You are very motivated!" Lai Yongchang said.
Xie Yu said to Lai Yongchang: "I invited you here today just to solve the problem! This, tonight, is my home court! Mr. Lin, thank you for providing the venue! Thank you!"
Anjing and the two security guards were still standing not far from the terrace and did not leave. The two security guards also looked at this place from time to time. I thought for a moment and called the three people over:
"Is something wrong with you?"
Jing Jing hesitated for a moment, then came over with two security guards: "Oh, Brother Fan, Mr. Lin..."
I interrupted her: "Just call me whatever you usually call me. There is no need to change your name."
Jing Jing relaxed obviously: "Brother Fan, oh, and Brother Longfeng, I have something to report to you. It's like this, these two colleagues from my department, one is from Sibi Village and the other is from Shanhou Village. They both signed up to join the army and passed! Get ready to report!"
"Oh, congratulations!" I said, "I wanted to join the army before but couldn't! If you can pass it, it means that you meet the national requirements in terms of physical health and political examination. It's a good thing! Why do you have such an expression? Our resort is a small family, and the country is everyone. It is natural for us to sacrifice our small family to protect everyone! I want to spread the word!"
The two security guards said: "Mr. Lin, oh, Brother Fan! Thank you!"
"Why are you thanking me?" I said, "This is all because you have not relaxed your demands on yourself and you have achieved what you have today!"
"If we hadn't been training in security work every day in the resort, we wouldn't necessarily have such a physique!" said one of the two security guards. "There is also the ideological principle of persistence. In the resort, we are taught every day to adhere to the principle and stand firm, so we have developed such a standard. I came here today just to say thank you and ask you to sign, we resign! It's a bit sad to give up, but as you said, leaving our small family to protect everyone is what we have to do and what we can do."
"Hey, resign?" I looked at Brother Longfeng, and he understood. "Resign? No approval!"
"Ah?" Jing Jing was stunned, and everyone present was stunned.
"I won't approve it if I don't!" Brother Longfeng said this seriously, and he laughed after saying it, "Why do you need to approve it? Even if you go to serve in the military, that's not the reason why we need to sign the resignation letter! We won't approve it! During the two years of service, the resort's wages and bonuses will still be paid! It should also be treated as one of our resort's achievements. Please contribute! If you two are willing to return to the resort and continue working, your service years will still be counted! But I have to tell you two! Don’t embarrass our Yinhai Bay, don’t embarrass your village, and don’t embarrass our resort!”
The two of them didn't expect such a result at all, and they stayed in place for a long time.
I said, "Hey, you two! Why are you as motionless as a big piece of wood! Remember it as soon as you hear it! Just five words: Don't embarrass us!"
Xie Yu smiled: "Lin Fan, these are six words! Your mathematics..."
"Hey, it's Zhang Wei's fault!" I rubbed the back of my head, "He keeps saying five words floating in the sky all day long! It's obviously seven words, misleading me!"
Brother Longfeng said to Jingjing: "As for you, their establishment remains unchanged, and their monthly salary statements and year-end bonuses must be reported! They cannot be left out! Also, report the names of their parents and get their bank account numbers. Our resort will pay living expenses to their parents every month! We have new recruits in our resort, so we must have a sense of glory, right? Haha!"
When the two security guards heard this arrangement, they were moved and pursed their lips without making a sound.
I looked at it and said, "Hey, nothing else? That's okay! Anjing, please confirm the time, and the resort will arrange a military banquet by the way! It's really settled!"
After An Jing left with two security guards, Lai Yongchang said to me: "General Lin is really worthy of me."Let’s study! "
I smiled and said, “Hey, protecting the homeland and the country is engraved in every Chinese’s genes, right? I used to sign up to be a soldier, but I failed. I failed the physical examination. There were only a few places, and I ranked at the bottom. What a pity! I'm sorry, and my dad is even more sorry. He was born as a soldier, so he left his hometown and is where he is today. I didn't join the army back then, and my dad said it was a pity that I missed that training opportunity. Then I signed up again the next year, again because I was ranked low and my physical fitness was passable, but still not as good as others. I will never forget it! Therefore, now there are people in our resort serving as soldiers, and we can still afford the salary. "
"Brother Fan, should we recruit those two security vacancies immediately? Brother Longfeng asked.
"That's for sure! "I said, "You don't need to ask me about your business. "
"It's not because the food hasn't been served yet. I'm afraid there's nothing to talk about, so I'll just join in and ask! "He looked at me with a smile.
Everyone laughed.
Lai Yongchang sighed: "Mr. Lin, you are right. If you didn’t grasp it well the first time, it won’t make sense if you don’t grasp it the second time. "
Xie Yu quickly changed the subject: "Yes! By the way, Lin... Oh, Mr., what’s the dish tonight? I saw that it was already being delivered not far away, right? A small train is coming! "
I spread my hands and said, "My hen!" Ask Brother Longfeng about this foodie! "
Brother Longfeng said: “We will arrange whatever we can. But don’t worry, it won’t be wasted! Oh, we all still echo what Yao Ming said, no business, no harm, we will never touch shark fins! Not even Wan Zai Wings. Fish, shrimp and crab! They are not the kind of fish, shrimps and crabs found in Stud, but the real ones from the sea. Some are farmed and some are wild. They are all carefully selected by the director of Sibi Village. Hey, don’t look at me. The village director can operate commercially. He has his own fishing boats and connections. However, there is no pickling or sashimi for safety reasons. Then, there is Sichuan food, authentic! Why is it said to be authentic? Because the chef is from Sichuan, he is an authentic chef. We, Brother Fan, have known the chef for more than ten years. When he took the chef license test, Brother Fan was his assistant and supported him. So, he didn't want to go anywhere, so he came to Yinwan Bay, where he is the chef of our Big Banyan Tree restaurant. "
"Can you finish eating? "Xie Yu asked.
"Can't finish it? "I laughed, "We never waste food. Calculated to produce. The percentage of waste is strictly controlled. If it exceeds that percentage, whoever takes the lead will pay the bill. "
"What if we encounter a flying guest? Xie Yu said, "Isn't it true that we can't do business even if we have business?" Isn't it a pity? Why do I feel so sorry? Wouldn't it be enough to work overtime? It only takes half an hour. For example, if you spend 300 yuan, the gross profit will be 150 yuan, right? The net profit is only 100 yuan, right? Isn’t it bad? "
